metadata.title: Godavari River Early Warning Flood Forecasting System
metadata.disclaimer: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE: Validated scientific demonstration for Vishnupuri Barrage. Evaluates causal forecast skill under strict non-leakage protocols.

source_1_imd_daily.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Gridded Daily Rainfall
source_1_imd_daily.center: Climate Research and Services (CRS), IMD Pune
source_1_imd_daily.missing_data_policy: Flagged as NaN; excluded from spatial mean; no synthetic zero-imputation
source_1_imd_daily.usage_role: Medium-range antecedent wetness context (1-day, 3-day, 7-day catchment accumulation)

source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.name: ISRO/MOSDAC INSAT-3DS Hydro-Estimator Method (HEM)
source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.missing_data_policy: Strict NaN preservation; partial hours explicitly flagged; zero forward/backward filling
source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.usage_role: High-frequency convective rain tracking for Event 1 rising-limb and lag correlation analysis

source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.name: Central Water Commission (CWC) / Maharashtra WRD Telemetry
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.sensor_type: Radar / Pressure Transducer River Stage Telemetry
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.units: Meters above mean sea level (m MSL)
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.usage_role: Hydrological forecast target and autoregressive stage feature foundation

Rainfall-Enhanced ML (Ridge).reason: Authentic rainfall dataset begins July 31 05:00 IST. Insufficient training samples before July 31 23:00 cutoff.

evaluation_metrics.experimental_disclaimer: EXPERIMENTAL CANDIDATE: Stage-Change + Rainfall (dH Model D) reduces MAE by 5.5%–6.8% over persistence during early flood inception, but matches persistence on flat pool and is unproven during peak cresting due to unmonitored spillway gate operations.

metadata.research_question: Does stage-change Ridge with upstream INSAT-3DS HEM rainfall features improve 1-3h river-stage forecasts compared with simpler and nonlinear alternatives?

properties.delineation_method: Pfafstetter topological flow routing terminating at outlet sub-basin 4081058170

properties.name: Vishnupuri Barrage & Godavari River Reach Corridor
Godavari River Downstream Reach (Nanded Urban Corridor)

parameters.notes: Catchment elevation spans 350.5 m MSL (outlet pour point) to 1,067 m MSL (headwaters), mean 540 m MSL. Local reach 10m LiDAR/drone DEM not pre-staged.

parameters.dataset_source: HydroBASINS Level 08 Sub-basin Attributes & SRTM Elevation Gradient
parameters.notes: Average main river channel slope is 1.1 m/km (0.11%). Mean basin slope is 2.8%. Reach gradient across Nanded corridor drops ~0.20 m/km.

parameters.dataset_source: IMD 0.25° Gridded Daily + ISRO MOSDAC INSAT-3DS HEM 4 km Half-Hourly + 7d API + Open-Meteo NWP
parameters.notes: 2,869 native INSAT-3DS HEM pixels across 51,768 km² catchment; 71 IMD grid cells; decaying API (alpha=0.90) memory tracking. Zero missingness in aligned benchmark subsets.

parameters.dataset_source: Central Water Commission (CWC) / Maharashtra WRD Telemetry (Station 006-SW-MAHA)
parameters.time_coverage: 1,154 verified records (2024); 2,568 verified records (2026); live NWIC probe
parameters.notes: FRL=355.0m, Warning=354.0m, Danger=354.8m. Stage telemetry is verified with zero synthetic imputation. Gate discharge rating curves and 18 radial gate positions are not public telemetry-published.

parameters.dataset_source: Bhuvan / NRSC / ESA WorldCover Upper Godavari Basin Inventory
parameters.notes: Catchment is ~72% cropland/agriculture, ~18% scrub/grassland, ~5% urban/settlements, ~4% water bodies, ~1% forest. Local ESA WorldCover tile staged in repository only covers Mumbai (N18E072); Nanded tile (N19E077) not pre-staged.

parameters.dataset_source: Open-Meteo Multi-Model NWP (7 Interior Catchment Points) + IMD Daily
parameters.spatial_resolution: Point grid across catchment (7 interior sampling points)
parameters.time_coverage: 2024–2026 active windows and real-time live feed
parameters.notes: Used for live catchment thermal diagnostics and surface evapotranspiration potential estimation.

river_features.source: HydroBASINS Level 08 Network & Godavari River Centerline
river_features.notes: Calculated relative to Godavari mainstem through Nanded corridor and major tributaries (Asna, Penganga junction).
51,768 km² drainage area terminating at outlet sub-basin 4081058170; 67 contributing sub-basins with upstream cumulative area 51,923 km².

river_features.feature: Historical Inundation Extent (JRC Global Surface Water)
river_features.source: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 Occurrence Tile (70E-80E, 10N-20N)
river_features.notes: 43,728 water recurrence pixels across the 1,231.5 km² corridor; 8,515 permanent pool pixels (>=80%), 25,756 seasonal flood pixels (20–80%), 9,457 ephemeral flood pixels (1–20%).

river_features.source: Maharashtra Water Resources Department (WRD) Technical Specifications
river_features.notes: Full Reservoir Level: 355.00 m MSL, Crest level: 347.50 m MSL. Real-time telemetry does not report gate opening heights or hourly spillway discharge.

river_features.source: Nanded Waghala City Municipal Corporation Survey & OpenStreetMap
river_features.notes: High-exposure zones: Govardhan Ghat, Nagina Ghat, Old Bridge riverfront, downstream agricultural floodplains below barrage.

ground_river_stage_flood_events.source: CWC / Maharashtra WRD verified stage observations (006-SW-MAHA)
ground_river_stage_flood_events.integrity_notes: Zero synthetic labels. Verified ground telemetry timestamps.

spatial_pixel_level_inundation_labels.source: Sentinel-1 SAR / Bhuvan Flood Inundation Maps
spatial_pixel_level_inundation_labels.status: DATA GAP (Not pre-staged for Godavari in local repository)
spatial_pixel_level_inundation_labels.integrity_rule: Strictly NO synthetic flood labels. High river stage or proximity does not prove pixel inundation without verified satellite flood masks.
spatial_pixel_level_inundation_labels.verdict: Spatial flood classification model CANNOT be trained with genuine ground truth until verified SAR flood masks for the Nanded reach are ingested.

readiness_summary.study_area_name: Vishnupuri Barrage & Godavari River Reach Study Area
readiness_summary.stage_forecasting_pipeline_status: OPERATIONAL (Model D, Persistence, Ridge, RF, XGBoost)
readiness_summary.spatial_inundation_model_status: DATA-DEFENSIVE AUDIT STAGE (Awaiting verified SAR flood masks)

distinct_task_separation.task_1_stage_forecasting: Predicts river stage at +1h, +2h, +3h at Vishnupuri Barrage using stage dynamics and upstream INSAT-3DS HEM rainfall features.
distinct_task_separation.task_2_flood_occurrence_classification: Predicts whether stage exceeds warning (354.0m) or danger (354.8m) thresholds at the barrage.
distinct_task_separation.task_3_spatial_inundation_mapping: Maps 2D water depth / inundation probability across the downstream Nanded floodplain (requires verified SAR masks).

annotations_2024.title: Full Window Maximum
annotations_2024.desc: Antecedent spate crest from late-July rain reaching 354.888 m MSL.

annotations_2024.title: Event 1 Rising Limb Onset
annotations_2024.desc: Stage trough at 353.388 m MSL before steep convective inflow surge.

annotations_2024.title: Rapid Surge Initiation
annotations_2024.desc: River stage begins rapid ascent (+0.291 m in 1 hour).

annotations_2024.title: Event 1 Crest (Peak)
annotations_2024.desc: True flood crest of Event 1 reaches 354.798 m MSL (+1.410 m rise over 34h).

annotations_2024.title: Post-Peak Test Start
annotations_2024.desc: Recession tail evaluation begins at 354.009 m MSL (9h after peak).

annotations_2026.title: 2026 Season Start
annotations_2026.desc: Pre-event flat baseline pool at ~350.8 m MSL. API initialized with 15-day warmup.

annotations_2026.title: Phase A Flood Inception
annotations_2026.desc: Monsoon flood wave inception onset (+1.41 m surge). 100% complete satellite rain.

annotations_2026.title: Satellite Payload Outage
annotations_2026.desc: INSAT-3DS operational payload offline (113 consecutive hours). Preserved strictly as NaN.

annotations_2026.title: Flood Crest (Radial Gates Open)
annotations_2026.desc: Barrage stage crests at ~355.18 m MSL. Regulated by unmonitored radial gate discharge.

annotations_2026.title: Satellite Scans Resumed
annotations_2026.desc: INSAT-3DS operational payload restored with valid scans.

annotations_2026.title: September Holdout Start
annotations_2026.desc: Synchronized held-out test subwindow begins under flat-pool quiescent conditions.

annotations_2026.title: September Holdout End
annotations_2026.desc: Evaluation subwindow ends. Stage-Change+Rain strictly matches persistence within <0.4mm.
